messages:
alex: Hey team — need to swap my Sun 22:00-06:00 oncall. Flight got pushed. I can cover Mon 06:00-14:00 instead. Will leave a handoff checklist and prewarm steps. Can someone take the night?

maria: I can pick up the Sun night if it's just monitoring and the usual canary checks. Quick Q: any scheduled rollouts or maint windows?

alex: Thanks @maria. There's a small canary rollout for the llm-serving changes at 23:00 (config-only, 5% traffic). No infra maint. Primary risks: increased latency if prefix cache cold + one pod failing to drain.

sam: I can shadow the first 2 hrs (22:00-00:00) and respond to alerts while you travel; someone else needs to cover 00:00-06:00 if @maria can't do the full night.

jordan: I can take 00:00-04:00 and hand off to @maria for 04:00-06:00 if that helps.

maria: That works — splitting it is fine. But I need a short checklist and the exact commands to prewarm the KV cache and warm model shards.

alex: Putting the checklist below. I'll paste runbook snippets and a one-line summary of what to watch for.

alex: RUNBOOK SNIPPET (paste into shell on the oncall host / console):
```
# check queues and tail logs
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime
kubectl -n inference logs -f deployment/llm-runtime --since=10m | sed -n '1,200p'

# prewarm KV cache for default model
curl -s -X POST $REDWOOD_API_URL/v1/admin/prewarm \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b", "prefixes":["Hello","Summarize:"]}'

# verify canary rollout status
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/llm-canary --watch
```

alex: Quick notes:
- Canary at 23:00 -> watch latency and error-rate on /v1/chat (route: user-facing).
- If latency > 500ms p50 for >5m, scale down canary and page infra.
- If Pod fails to drain on deploy, restart that pod and run `kubectl describe pod <pod>` to check OOM or liveliness.

maria: Got it. One more: any customers on scheduled demos overnight? I can block DMs if so.

alex: No external demos. There's a partner demo scheduled Mon 10:00, but that's after your night. I put a note in the handoff doc about the partner model variant — Mon morning rollout ties into it (we pin to quantized variant until 09:30).

deploy-bot: [23:00] Canary rollout started for llm-serving v3.2 -> 5% traffic. Link: https://deploys.redwood.example/canary/12345 :rocket:

sam: Quick confirmation: who will post the handoff message at 06:00 with incident detection summary? Last time that was missed and it caused confusion.

jordan: I'll post the 06:00 handoff summary to #eng-oncall and drop notes in the shared doc.

alex: Appreciate it all. I'll update the shared oncall doc with exact tokens and the prewarm payload before I leave. Leaving my mobile on for urgent pages until 21:30. :pray:
